name: youtube-mcp
description: YouTube MCP server and skills: upload, publish and schedule YouTube videos and Shorts with titles, descriptions and privacy settings through YouTube's official API, via PostOnce.

interface.shortDescription: Upload, publish and schedule YouTube videos and Shorts.
interface.longDescription: Skills for YouTube titles, descriptions, tags, scripts, Shorts, thumbnails and content calendars, plus uploading and scheduling videos to your YouTube channel. Publishing goes through YouTube's official API, via PostOnce.
interface.defaultPrompt: Write a title and description for this video and schedule it on my YouTube channel for Thursday at 3pm.
